content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides information on the costs of short-acting human regular insulin. The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for a U-100 vial of this insulin is $172. The National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) for the same vial ranges between $137 and $142. Prefilled insulin pens for this type of insulin are priced at approximately $208, with the NADAC for these pens being $166.
